justification: Claims C1, C2 (directionally), and C3 were tested on an independent proxy dataset (2D forced Kolmogorov turbulence) since the paper's Schlieren data is proprietary. All three tested claims reproduced in direction and mechanism: adversarial training mitigates spectral bias, adv-NO trades higher field NRMSE (+30% vs paper's +22%) for substantially better spectral fidelity, and high-wavenumber energy recovery is dramatically improved (19.5x at k=30). However, the magnitude of spectral error reduction (2.6x) is much smaller than the paper's reported 15x, plausibly due to the smaller model, shorter training, simpler feature loss (spatial gradients vs VGG-19+RaGAN), and different flow regime. C4 (3D HIT forecasting and sparse PTV reconstruction) was explicitly out of scope. Given correct direction/mechanism on all tested claims but numerical gap and untested claims, PARTIAL is the appropriate verdict.
